summary: GDS Holdings Limited filed Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, solely to announce that it will report its second quarter 2026 unaudited financial results on August 13, 2026, before the U.S. market open, with an earnings conference call to follow. The filing includes a board meeting announcement and routine contact details. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or management change is referenced. This is an ordinary earnings schedule notice, not a special situation.
